reports.desc: Received an email that I purchased a coffee maker for over $500 it looked like a PayPal receipt. They had an email address I no longer use & I wasn't sure if that email was on PayPal account

The person reached out Via Monster job search. With an offer and I code to identify myself. Indicating the position was for a manager position. I ended getting the job. Give personal information. From there, my bank account got blocked. Then tried taking out loans on my personal information. That’s when I decided to stop all contact.

Capris were ordered. A pack of 5. I helped my mother order them. Unfortunately, we didn’t check out the company prior and didn’t see the website return name which would have been a clue as well as no confirmation. The phone number was a personal number saying it is not associated with any clothing.

I ordered from an ad on my phone.  After I placed the order I found out from the real company that the link they used was  a scam link.  I attempted to email them and told them i wanted  a return label because I was returning the product. They never responded.  There is no phone number to contact them.  After the order was placed the ad never came back.  I received the product today.  I do not know how to return it and get a refund.

I purchased discounted jeans from the website that i never received. I attempted to reach out when i noticed the tracking said it was delivered when it did not arrive and was told they would send out another package. Again i was told it was delivered and nothing. I teied to get my money back and they never responded after that

4Ever Home Warranty using unethical sales/scare tactics in attempts to get people to call them, and convince them to get their insurance.
If they are this dishonest in their attempts to get clients, I doubt that they are honest when it comes to paying out claims.

I ordered a pair of sandals from Northend Shop in what I thought was located in Denver, Colorado. I received a cheap pair of plastic Sandals from China. They are wanting me to pay to have them shipped back at my expense. Which is half the price of what I paid for the shoes. I even sent them pictures and they refuse to resolve this any other way! Never order from this company. When you call them they tell you to leave a message and never return your call!  When looking at reviews they look good until you research the company! DO NOT ORDER FROM NORTHEND SHOP!

My mother bought me a gift card for christmas. I have tried over and over to get the beinifits of the card but nothing has every happened. I think they try to make it so technical and hard so people just give up. The process is as such.......
1. Get on their site pick where you want you card from.
2. Supposed to get an e mail with said spendable card.
3. Print out and spend money where ever you have chossen.
I have never received anything from them and their customer service number is crap. Both of them!
I ordered some capris& supposedly fed ex called & said package was lost.i called fed ex the tracking number doesn't exist.So i lost my money...

I ask for a loan for $2000.00, they okay we can help you. First we send you 1477.00 and send it back using chim or cash app. I send the money back through cash app. Now my bank said I am negative-1477.00 because the check they submitted was a fake,  now that leaves me pay back the bank.
Said they was debt relief and i was  Qualified for UP to $42000 in debt relief. Just call Sarah  at mdsl 866 510 6219 i checked it out here first  did not call them back
I received a call talking about someone trying have me sign a letter. The person hand no information just told me to call 855 762 4025
I keep receiving these calls. I have never not paid taxes. I don’t know why they are calling me.

Ordered 3 dresses for granddaughter hoco. One came not at all the dress, not new no tags worn deodorant stains. Second package never came. Wanted me to pat for shipping return to china.!! Never again!!
I fell for it! I am so ****** off at myself for even thinking this was ligit!  Never again.  Lesson learned.
